sources.role: Checker predictions and availability categories are indicative network-level information. They cannot independently establish live orderability, exact corrected r2 coverage or measured speed for a selected parcel.

sources.source: Mobile coverage checker frequently asked questions
sources.role: Mobile coverage predictions, sampled verification and postal-district performance cannot be transferred to fixed-broadband parcel serviceability or parcel-measured speed.

sources.source: About the Ofcom mobile and broadband checker
sources.role: Predicted speeds and network submissions can be incomplete or differ from operational availability. They cannot be treated as exact selected-parcel orderability or a measured speed.

sources.source: One million people have mapped their mobile – have you?
sources.role: Consumer-tool usage, crowdsourced mobile experience and operator predictions are mobile comparison context, not fixed-broadband parcel verification.
Address and postal-district mobile coverage/performance indicators are not national results and cannot establish fixed-broadband coverage or parcel speed.
Consumer troubleshooting and handset guidance do not verify fixed-broadband network availability, live orderability or measured parcel speed.
An evaluation design and future assessment timeline cannot establish current serviceability or measured speed for selected parcels.

sources.authority: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology / Building Digital UK
sources.role: Technical modelling assumptions and qualitative evaluation evidence do not establish serviceability or measured speed for surrounding selected parcels.

sources.authority: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology / Building Digital UK
sources.role: A programme process summary describes delivery mechanisms and public-building connections; it cannot promote surrounding parcels to verified coverage.
Corporate objectives, budgets, targets and programme descriptions are planning evidence, not current selected-parcel serviceability or measured speed.
Multi-year delivery trajectories and strategic targets do not prove current orderability or measured performance for selected parcels.

sources.source: Open Market Review determinations and BDUK plans
sources.role: A collection of OMR determinations and BDUK plan files requires exact UPRN-level temporal and schema validation before any selected-parcel promotion.
A publication collection and aggregate performance series do not independently establish current selected-parcel network availability or measured speed.

sources.source: Building Digital UK Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.role: Annual-report programme totals, accounting measures and national coverage milestones cannot verify current serviceability or speed for selected parcels.

sources.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - East and West Sussex
sources.role: Contract scope, redesign and planned premises are procurement evidence. They do not prove present-day orderability or measured speed for selected parcels.
